top_signals.title: Rising Fuel Flows Through Hormuz May Help Ease Strained Market
top_signals.summary: The volume of refined products being loaded within the Persian Gulf is rising, with most of that exiting the Strait of Hormuz and providing some relief to one of the tightest corners of the global oil market nine months into the Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: SoftBank Group shares surge 13% as Asian tech stocks track Wall Street rebound
top_signals.summary: A sharp decline in oil prices lifted sentiment while renewed buying in semiconductor names overnight spilled over into Asia, following last week's bruising sell-off.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Australia plans new regulator for artificial intelligence after OpenAI hack
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
